name: Lawrence Allen Almazan
headline: Full-stack engineer shipping AI from cloud to device.
tagline: Full-stack AI engineer shipping products from cloud to device.
intro: 4+ years building serverless backends on AWS, mobile apps in React Native and Flutter, and AI features from RAG chatbots to on-device models. I make games on the side.
bio: I'm a full-stack AI engineer based in Cavite, Philippines. At IfElse PH I own the server side of two products: a digital wallet, and an over-the-air update platform that delivers new software to LGES battery systems. I work directly with the embedded team, so the cloud side and the hardware side are designed together rather than handed over.

Before IfElse, I built serverless Python services on AWS at PDAX, a Philippine digital asset exchange, and kept a Node.js platform running for Stream Nation's users. I also spent three years freelancing, delivering cloud backends, React Native apps and machine-learning models for companies and individual clients, including a RAG-based AI assistant for the University of Batangas.

Outside client work I ship open-source software: a Minecraft launcher and server manager written in Rust, a planning tool for AI coding agents, and indie games in Godot. I studied Computer Science at Cavite State University, and my teams placed first runner-up at HackForGov 2 and fourth at HackForGov 3.

experience.note: Own the server side of a digital wallet and an over-the-air update platform for LGES battery systems, working directly with embedded engineers on how updates reach the hardware.
Maintained a Node.js platform serving 300+ users on an AWS serverless, microservice architecture.
Built the company's React Native app end to end, integrated Shopify for the product catalogue, and owned CI/CD for both the app and its server.
Built serverless Python services on AWS, defined in CloudFormation, for a Philippine digital asset exchange. Designed API routes test-first and wrote PySpark jobs for data processing.
Delivered cloud backends on AWS, React Native apps, machine-learning models and a RAG-based AI assistant for the University of Batangas, alongside indie and roguelike games.
